info.title: API.SH: Carvana
info.description: The Carvana API from API.SH: public Carvana data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Every Carvana search filter with counts for the given filters: makes with models and trims, body styles, colors, drivetrains, cylinders, transmissions, sizes, fuel types, features, tags and categories, and the price, year, mileage, MPG, seats, horsepower, towing and warranty ranges. Takes the same filters as /carvana/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carvana-filters

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cars in Carvana's inventory, 24 per page (up to 100 with `limit`): price, KBB value, MSRP, market adjustment, mileage, VIN, year, make, model, trim, colors, fuel, MPG, seats, horsepower, towing, cargo, warranty left, tags (great deal, single owner, no accidents...), delivery and photos. Filter by make, model and trim, body style, colors, drivetrain, cylinders, transmission, size, fuel, features, tags and categories, and ranges for price, year, mileage, MPG, seats, horsepower, towing and warranty miles. The response also lists every filter value with counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carvana-search

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model(s) of the first make, comma-separated.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Features (all must match), e.g. Apple CarPlay,Heated Seats.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag ids from `filters.tags` (all must match), e.g. 21 (no reported accidents), 20 (single owner).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Carvana car: price and previous price, KBB value, fair market value, MSRP, VIN, specs and dimensions, MPG, Carvana's feature categories, packages and options, highlights, why-buy notes, recalls, prior use, accidents, number of keys, warranties, the 150-point inspection, cosmetic imperfections with photos, location and photos. Sold cars answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carvana-vehicle

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Carvana vehicle id (vehicle_id in search), or a carvana.com/vehicle/<id> link in `url`. Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true = the first car of a search with the make/model/filter params of /carvana/v1/search, instead of an id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
